A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with all 19 pages readable, including the checklist and Appendices A-G. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish identical scientific content without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original puppeteering-detection experiments in Tables 1-2, ablations and robustness results in Tables 4-7, and runtime measurements in Section 7.

after.justification: v4 retains those original detection experiments, ablations, robustness results, and runtime measurements, including the supplementary results in Appendix B.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains identical EBL projection heads, pose-conditioned contrastive loss, extreme-pose filtering, and LSTM temporal fusion. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use NVIDIA-VC, RAVDESS, and CREMA-D with the same five generators. Combined-dataset evaluation, cross-domain testing, and appearance-modification scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1-2 evaluate the same seven deepfake detectors and Vahdati et al. Avatar Fingerprinting remains explicitly excluded in both versions.

E3.justification: The identity-disjoint splits, dataset counts in Table 3, AUC metric, cross-domain protocol, and training and temporal-window settings are identical.

E4.justification: Tables 4-7 and Figure 4 retain the same component ablations, pose sensitivity, appearance robustness, temporal-window analysis, and training-identity scaling results.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting and the statistical-significance checklist entry are identical. No repeated-run information, uncertainty intervals, or statistical tests are added, removed, or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings match, including Tables 1-7. For example, the proposed method's average cross-domain AUC in Table 2 remains 0.925.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, Proposition 1, its assumptions, and the complete proof and derivations in Appendix G are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about enrollment-free latent-domain defense, biometric leakage, real-time performance, and generalization.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged, as are Section 7's pose, lighting, and motion-blur limitations and Appendices E-F's fairness and intended-use qualifications.

D1.justification: Generation and training details in Appendices C-D, optimization hyperparameters, compute disclosures, and the code/model access link are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the comparisons with prior defenses, and all 72 references are identical. Research positioning and novelty statements do not change.

P1.justification: The arXiv stamp changes from v3 dated 10 April 2026 to v4 dated 12 May 2026. PDF title metadata changes 'Disarm' to 'Expose' and adjusts capitalization; displayed titles, prose, and document organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1-6, Tables 1-7, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages match exactly except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: v4 only updates administrative version information and title metadata. The scientific text, experimental evidence, proofs, reproducibility information, and visual presentation remain unchanged throughout the main paper and appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall quality.
